source_limits: Direct official playlist, watch-page playlist context and public embed playlist did not expose a usable episode list from this server.
Targeted public episode-number searches supplied candidate IDs only; all imports independently passed official YouTube watch metadata and oEmbed.
Search results often returned a different season than requested. Official SxEy title notation alone determined placement.
Thirteen candidate watch pages had no videoDetails on two ordinary attempts. Held as metadata-unverifiable, not proven unauthorized or India-blocked.
No region spoofing, restriction bypass or non-YouTube media fetching was used.
Actual India playback was not observed. IN country metadata and public oEmbed passed; all seasons remain verified_complete:false.
